title: Your first encounter in noctune — web

headline: Start an
encounter.
scenes.narration: Here's how to take an appointment from recording to client follow-up in noctune. Choose New Encounter, select your patient, and choose the templates for your clinical note and discharge instructions.

headline: Record or
upload audio.
scenes.narration: Record the appointment in your browser, or upload an existing audio file. Review the queued recording, then choose Process file to submit it.

headline: Give the draft
time to prepare.
scenes.narration: noctune transcribes the recording and prepares draft notes. You can leave this screen and return from the Encounters queue when the draft is ready.

headline: Review the
clinical note.
scenes.narration: Review the clinical note against the transcript and audio. Check the patient details, findings, and plan. The draft is a starting point for your clinical review.

headline: Edit, save,
and complete.
scenes.narration: Choose Edit to make corrections, then Save. When your review is finished, choose Complete. Saving an edit and completing the encounter are separate steps.

headline: Send reviewed
instructions.
scenes.narration: Review the discharge instructions before sending them. Choose Send Email, then Send discharge notes. Confirm the recipient and send. Drafts are never sent automatically.

headline: Keep follow-up
in context.
scenes.narration: Open Messages to follow up with your client. Encounter-linked replies keep the conversation connected to the visit. That's the workflow: record, review, and follow up.
